relationships.evidence_quote: Acupuncture reduced acute cocaine-induced locomotor activity and DA release in a point-specific manner, which was blocked by optogenetic silencing or chemical lesion of the RMTg.

key_findings: Acupuncture reduced acute cocaine-induced locomotion and DA release via activation of RMTg GABA neurons.
The acupuncture effect required RMTg and its LHb/fasciculus retroflexus inputs.
